eventDetail.scope: The event fosters interdisciplinary dialogue between academia and industry, promotes research-industry collaboration, and offers paper presentations, invited talks, special sessions, and technical activities. In partnership with the IEEE Council on RFID, IWSA 2026 will explore CRFID-focused initiatives, such as dedicated sessions or talks, to highlight RFID's role in advancing wireless sensing innovation and real-world deployment.
